\section{Canonical notation and units}
\label{sec:notation}

The symbols in Table~\ref{tab:notation} are normative in both views of this
contract.  The generic signal unit is denoted by $U$.  The admitted upstream
boundary presently names a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent quantity
in \texttt{mJy/beam}; the symbol $U$ keeps the algebra explicit and does not
turn a component token into a physical Stokes assertion.

\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.18\textwidth}
                        >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.50\textwidth}
                        >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.23\textwidth}@{}}
\caption{Canonical notation.}\label{tab:notation}\\
\toprule
Symbol & Meaning and domain & Unit \\
\midrule
\endfirsthead
\toprule
Symbol & Meaning and domain & Unit \\
\midrule
\endhead
$a$ & Stable TolTEC array identity, exactly one of \texttt{a1100},
\texttt{a1400}, or \texttt{a2000}. & identity \\
$i$ & Exact admitted PTC occurrence on stable RTC output sample $n$, with
observation, detector occurrence/UID, PTC application generation, segment,
array, and immutable parents. & identity \\
$p$ & Target pixel in one exact JINC destination WCS. & identity \\
$\boldsymbol{u}_i=(x_i,y_i)$ & Exact finite AST continuous FITS pixel
coordinate for occurrence $i$ in the target JINC WCS. & pixel \\
$\boldsymbol{c}_i$ & Integer FITS pixel-center coordinate selected from
$\boldsymbol{u}_i$ by Equation~\eqref{eq:rounded-center}. & pixel \\
$\boldsymbol{\phi}_i$ & Exact residual phase
$\boldsymbol{u}_i-\boldsymbol{c}_i$ in
$[-\tfrac12,\tfrac12)^2$. & pixel \\
$n_{\mathrm{sub}}$ & Effective integer phase resolution represented by
\texttt{subpixel\_n}; $n_{\mathrm{sub}}\ge1$. & $1$ \\
$\boldsymbol{q}_i$ & Two-axis phase-bin index in
$\{0,\ldots,n_{\mathrm{sub}}-1\}^2$. & index \\
$\widehat{\boldsymbol{\phi}}_i$ & Midpoint representative of the exact
half-open phase bin selected by $\boldsymbol{q}_i$. & pixel \\
$\beta_i$ & Exact axis-1-fast linear phase index
$q_{i1}+n_{\mathrm{sub}}q_{i2}$. & index \\
$\mathcal{K}_{i\boldsymbol d}$ & Logical coefficient-cache key
$(\beta_i,d_1,d_2)$, equivalent to $(q_{i1},q_{i2},d_1,d_2)$. & identity \\
$\mathbf{M}$ & Exact two-by-two affine tangent-plane pixel matrix of the
target WCS, including axis order, signs, rotation, and handedness. &
angle per pixel \\
$\Delta$ & Positive target-pixel angular scale satisfying
$\mathbf{M}^{\mathsf T}\mathbf{M}=\Delta^2\mathbf{I}$ for the base-v0.1
square-pixel WCS class. & angle per pixel \\
$\mathcal{D}$ & Finite destination pixel-center domain
$\{1,\ldots,N_x\}\mathbin{\times}\{1,\ldots,N_y\}$. & identity \\
$h_a$ & Integer square-cache half-width
$\lceil s_a(r_{\max})_a/\Delta\rceil$. & pixel \\
$\boldsymbol{d}$ & Integer cache offset in
$\{-h_a,\ldots,h_a\}^2$. & pixel \\
$z_i$ & Exact finite transformed signal $Z_i^{\mathrm{PTC}}$. & $U$ \\
$\omega_i$ & Positive, finite, PTC-produced analysis/gridding coefficient
from one exact registered family/version that permits SCI-JINC. & $1$ or
$U^{-2}$, as declared by its family \\
$\kappa_{ip}$ & Signed, dimensionless analytic JINC coefficient at the
selected point phase.  Finite positive, exact-zero, and finite negative values
are distinct legitimate analytic results. & $1$ \\
$w_{ip}$ & Complete signed contribution coefficient,
$w_{ip}=\omega_i\kappa_{ip}$. & unit of $\omega_i$ \\
$I_{ip}$ & Boolean membership after sample admission, exact AST association,
rounded-center domain admission, local square geometry, and all pixel-local
gates. & $1$ \\
$s_a$ & Explicit angular radial scale associated with stable array $a$;
finite and strictly positive in any numerical realization. & angle \\
$r$ & Generic angular separation used by the analytic family. & angle \\
$\widehat r_{i\boldsymbol d}$ & Exact discrete angular separation between the
representative sample phase and destination pixel center for cache offset
$\boldsymbol d$, from Equation~\eqref{eq:discrete-radius}. & angle \\
$r'_a$ & Dimensionless radius $r/s_a$, finite and nonnegative. & $1$ \\
$j_{1,1}$ & Exact first positive zero
$\min\{x>0:J_1(x)=0\}$ of the first-order Bessel function. & $1$ \\
$a_a,\allowbreak b_a,\allowbreak c_a,\allowbreak (r_{\max})_a$ & Ordered, dimensionless analytic shape tuple for
array $a$; every member is finite and strictly positive in an authorized
numerical realization. & $1$ \\
$\boldsymbol{\theta}_a$ & Complete kernel parameter identity
$(s_a,a_a,b_a,c_a,(r_{\max})_a)$, including owner, source, version, units,
array association, and lifecycle state. & mixed, as above \\
$N_p$ & Signed signal numerator. & $U[\omega]$ \\
$C_p$ & Signed normalization; it may be finite and negative, but exact zero is
never accepted. & $[\omega]$ \\
$Q_p$ & Quadratic accumulator; finite and strictly positive on accepted local
support. & $[\omega]$ \\
$m_p$ & Normalized estimate $N_p/C_p$ on accepted local support. & $U$ \\
$D_p$ & Absolute-term sum $\sum_i I_{ip}|\omega_i\kappa_{ip}|$, used only as
construction state for conditioning. & $[\omega]$ \\
$\rho_p$ & Dimensionless cancellation statistic $|C_p|/D_p$. & $1$ \\
$\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$ & Exact owner-approved numerical-adequacy
profile, including its observable, norm, domain, error treatment, exact
inequality, uncertainty rule, lifecycle, and provenance. & identity \\
$\mathcal{E}_p$ & Exact numerical-adequacy certificate for pixel $p$ under
$\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$. & identity \\
$G_a$ & Compact bundle-level generative record for one observation and array;
it identifies immutable parents, selections, joins, operator state, lifecycle,
and completion without storing dense per-contribution provenance. & identity \\
$A_{pi}$ & Fixed-state normalized linear operator row
$I_{ip}\omega_i\kappa_{ip}/C_p$. & $1$ \\
$f_{s,i}$ & Effective processed-sample frequency, finite and strictly
positive. & $\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ \\
$T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$ & Required \texttt{jinc\_coefficient\_squared\_time}
accumulator. & $\mathrm{s}$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

In-memory indices are zero-based.  Persisted FITS/WCS pixel coordinates and
the mathematical coordinates in Equations~\eqref{eq:rounded-center}--
\eqref{eq:discrete-radius} are one-based at integer pixel centers.  Memory
order never supplies axis sign, handedness, orientation, or wrapping.
